video_title: Boogie & Chandler - KAT is a Hall of Famer with NBA Championship?!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns faces unfair pressure to succeed with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: If the Knicks don't win, it's his fault, not Jalen Brunson's.
quotes.quote: I feel like he's always been the one on the chopping block. He's always been the piece that's going to get moved if we fail. If the Knicks don't win, it's his fault, not Jalen Brunson's. He's had the up and down roller coaster of a career since he's been there. I think KAT is one of the best, most talented big men in the game today, and he's got an opportunity right now to solidify that.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: An NBA title would secure Karl-Anthony Towns' Hall of Fame legacy
quotes.excerpt: You put a title next to that and he puts himself in a different level.
quotes.quote: Six-time All-Star, three-time All-NBA, I think you put a ring next to that, I think he's a shoe-in for Hall of Fame. Right now, if it ends, no, I don't think so. Mitch Richmond got in with six All-Stars and maybe a couple more All-NBAs, but you put a title next to that and he's not going to get more NBA All-Stars, I think he puts himself in a different level of success and it's obviously going to help his legacy.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Winning a championship would change the narrative surrounding Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: He becomes a winning player and the whole narrative around his name changes in general.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: That was my follow-up, is that it?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I think it just puts respect on his name. He's an easy target to criticize and people like to make fun of how he speaks and this and that. He wins an NBA title, you have to put some respect on KAT's name.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I think it brings respect, I think it validates an incredible resume. Obviously he has a chance at being a Hall of Famer if this is able to win a championship. At the end of the day, I think he gets the narrative of being a winning player which every player wants in this league. It dismisses a lot of the negativity around his name, which he actually deserves. He becomes a winning player and the whole narrative around his name changes in general.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's legacy is tied to winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: Anything accomplished from this point moving forward is all towards your legacy.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Anything accomplished from this point moving forward is all towards your legacy. It's the same thing with KAT, with Jalen Brunson. He now puts himself in a different realm of greatness. Obviously being the star and the face of this New York Knicks team, I think he staples himself within this organization long-term, which every player wants at some point in their career. We're talking about players' jerseys going in the rafters, possibly statues, things of that nature. For Brunson, he becomes an all-time Knick and he has a chance to put his jersey in the rafters.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: It's kind of funny that we don't say that about KAT. Like he doesn't become a Hall of Famer.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: They win, he becomes the best Knick of all time.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Winning a title would cement Mike Brown's coaching legacy
quotes.excerpt: For Mike Brown to have three championships as an assistant, swept as a head coach, and then have an opportunity to get right back and get one for himself, that does everything for him.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: We're going down the line, legacy, legacy, legacy. For Mike Brown to have three championships as an assistant, swept as a head coach, and then have an opportunity to get right back and get one for himself, that does everything for him. That puts him in the conversation with the greats, along with the players. How a championship will put them in different conversations with some of the icons of the game. It's going to do the same thing for Mike Brown. He's always been a quality coach. I've rarely heard anything negative about him. I've always heard that he can coach his ass off and do his thing, but he can win a championship on his own two feet as the head coach in New York City, that puts him in a different environment, different stratosphere.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: It just packs a bigger punch to win a championship for the Knicks. This is just a different level of success and respect and recognition that you get when you are in that market and it's huge. The success he's had, he's been hired and fired multiple times, but now we're talking about him being on the chopping block a couple months ago. It's such a volatile place to coach and play where if it's what have you not done for me lately, you're out. I think we've now at least know that he's going to be the coach for the future. This team should stay together, no matter what happens in this finals, they're on to something and they have a great coach in Mike Brown.
